title: Sound Detector
description: Detects nearby sounds and displays directional arrows on the HUD showing the source direction, type, and distance.
body:
🎧 Sound Detector

Advanced, high-performance sound radar designed for competitive and immersive gameplay.

Developed by Markesr

---
## 🔍 What is Sound Detector? **Sound Detector** is a next-generation HUD mod by **CoreStudio** that visually maps nearby sounds on your screen. Instead of simple text spam, it features a highly optimized, dynamically rotating circular radar. Whether you're tracking hostile mobs in dark caves, pinpointing players in PvP, or just exploring, this mod gives you the ultimate situational awareness. ### ⚡ Technical Excellence & Performance * **BufferBuilder Chevron Rendering:** Unlike older mods that use ugly text brackets (like `[!]`), our arrows are natively drawn on the GPU using `BufferBuilder` for razor-sharp, modern chevron shapes. * **High-FPS Camera Interpolation:** The radar calculates the player's exact head yaw and `tickDelta`. When you quickly flick your mouse, the radar elements spin with butter-smooth 144Hz+ fluidity—no stuttering, no 20 TPS jitter. * **Smart Sound Grouping:** If a horde of 10 zombies groans at the same time, the mod intelligently groups them based on proximity, preventing screen clutter and UI spam. ---
### 🛠️ Advanced Features * ⚔️ **Intelligent Combat Fade:** Don't let UI block your vision. When you swing a weapon, use an item, or take damage, the radar smoothly fades out. It features a **5.5-second persistence delay** before fading back in, ensuring your focus remains unbroken during intense fights. * 🌈 **Asynchronous RGB Mode:** Enable the Chroma setting to apply a perfectly offset, continuous RGB phase shift to each individual sound arrow. * 🌍 **Native Engine Localization:** The mod directly taps into Minecraft's `I18n` (Internationalization) engine. This means entity and block names automatically translate into the exact language your game is set to—flawlessly. * 📏 **Pixel-Perfect Customization:** Don't like the radar in the center of the screen? Use the settings menu to adjust the **Radar X/Y Offsets**, change the radius, and scale the text/arrow sizes completely independently. ### 🌐 Global Language Support The mod natively supports the most active Minecraft communities worldwide: `English`, `Turkish`, `Spanish`, `Russian`, `German`, `Portuguese (BR)`, `Chinese (Simplified)`, `French`, `Polish`. ### 📥 Dependencies To use this mod, please make sure you have the following installed in your mods folder: * [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) * [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) * [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) *(Recommended for the in-game `V` settings menu)* ---
Enjoying the mod? Don't forget to follow CoreStudio for future projects!
